source_keys.role: independently keyed signed OPEX primitives and source-period identities
independently keyed issuer reconciliation cells, dates/layout/cross-references

authority.independence: Expected values were prepared from pinned source tables and adopted method; no Product output or calculation implementation was consulted.

method.units: USD millions from source declared USD unit, inline scale, and source table captions; issuer visible-only recon values use printed table unit_basis
method.signed_cogs: negative reported positive COGS expense magnitude
method.signed_opex: -(positive SG&A face amount + positive intangible-amortization face amount)
method.signed_d_and_a: negative separately reported issuer reconciliation depreciation and amortization amount
method.delta_convention: calculated amount minus the separately reported source amount
method.acceptance: Exact nominal deltas retained. No tolerance or reconciliation verdict supplied.

join_keys: source runtime alias plus raw source identity
exact start date and end date
period_join_policy.statement_periods: Source context periods from the frozen OPEX/source keys; no new period synthesized.
period_join_policy.issuer_visible_only_cells: Bind each native cell by expanded rowspan/colspan grid intersection with actual date and duration headers. For Q1FY25 comparative cells, retain the pinned layout rule that both date columns join the sole printed thirteen-week duration group although its colspan ends before comparative value columns.
period_join_policy.xbrl_context: Income statement cells retain actual inline context/unit identities. Issuer reconciliation cells have no inline fact descendants; no external contextRef or unitRef is asserted. Their date/duration/unit/entity derive from the native table caption, headers, and pinned reconciliation layout.
